trigger: Shift end time passed with no punch-out recorded.
knowledge_base: This is the shortest and lightest of the five calls. The operator is tired and heading home - keep it to two turns if possible.
If the operator has already left the site, log the exception and tell them the supervisor will regularise it. Never ask them to return.
If the operator is still working, log it as an extended shift - an unlogged shift overrun matters.
The punch-out itself is verified from the system, never from the operator's word - any claim of having punched out is flagged for recheck.
Do not attempt app or scanner troubleshooting on the call. Log it as a technical exception and escalate to the supervisor.
Salary, wages, OT rates and payment questions must be deferred to HR or the app.
Never mention consequences, warnings or disciplinary action. Thank them for the shift before closing.

en.opening: Hello {employee_name}, your duty has ended and your punch-out has not been recorded yet. Please punch out before leaving {terminal}.
en.attempt_2_opening: Hello {employee_name}, this is a follow-up reminder - your punch-out is still pending. Please complete it now so your attendance is closed properly.
en.silence_reply: It seems you're unable to respond right now. Please punch out as soon as possible. Thank you!

still_working.description: Operator is still working or on an extended shift / doing OT now.
still_working.reply: Understood, we've noted this as an extended shift. Please punch out once you're done. Thank you!

already_punched.description: Operator says they already punched out.
already_punched.reply: Understood, we'll recheck this in the system. Thank you!

technical_issue.description: Operator reports a scanner, machine or system problem preventing the punch-out.
technical_issue.reply: I'm sorry for the trouble. I'll inform your supervisor right away. Thank you!

supervisor.description: Operator wants to speak to a supervisor or a human.
supervisor.reply: I'll pass this on to your supervisor, {supervisor_name}. Thank you!

wrong_number.description: Wrong number or the person is not the named operator.
wrong_number.reply: I'm sorry for the inconvenience. I'll correct this on our end. Thank you!

hi.opening: नमस्ते {employee_name}, आपकी ड्यूटी समाप्त हो गई है और अभी तक आपका पंच-आउट दर्ज नहीं हुआ है। कृपया {terminal} छोड़ने से पहले पंच-आउट करें।
hi.attempt_2_opening: हेलो {employee_name} भाई, ये फॉलो-अप रिमाइंडर है — आपका पंच-आउट अभी भी पेंडिंग है। कृपया अभी पूरा कर दीजिए ताकि आपकी अटेंडेंस सही से क्लोज़ हो जाए।
hi.silence_reply: ऐसा लगता है कि आप अभी उत्तर नहीं दे पा रहे हैं। कृपया जितनी जल्दी हो सके पंच-आउट करें। आपका धन्यवाद!

already_punched.description: Operator says they already punched out.
already_punched.reply: समझ गया, हम इसे सिस्टम में दोबारा जांच लेंगे। आपका धन्यवाद!

gu.opening: નમસ્તે {employee_name}, તમારી ડ્યુટી પૂરી થઈ ગઈ છે અને હજુ સુધી તમારો પંચ-આઉટ નોંધાયો નથી. કૃપા કરી {terminal} છોડતા પહેલા પંચ-આઉટ કરો.

gu.silence_reply: એવું લાગે છે કે તમે અત્યારે જવાબ આપી શકતા નથી. કૃપા કરી બની શકે એટલું જલ્દી પંચ-આઉટ કરો. તમારો આભાર!
